response.sql: SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) FROM (SELECT m.MediaTypeId, AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds) AS avg_ratio FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes > 10323804 GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name) x

assumptions.assumption: "Pass a cutoff of 10,323,804 bytes" means Bytes strictly greater than 10,323,804 (a minimum size threshold).

Per-media-type average is the mean of per-track Bytes/Milliseconds ratios (not total bytes / total milliseconds). Media types with no qualifying tracks are excluded; the outer average is unweighted across media types.
Division is done in floating point to avoid integer division; tracks with NULL Bytes are excluded by the filter.

alternatives.sql: SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) FROM (SELECT m.MediaTypeId, AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds) AS avg_ratio FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes >= 10323804 GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name) x

alternatives.interpretation: Per-media-type average is computed as total bytes divided by total milliseconds (weighted) rather than the mean of per-track ratios.
alternatives.sql: SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) FROM (SELECT m.MediaTypeId, CAST(SUM(t.Bytes) AS REAL) / SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS avg_ratio FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes > 10323804 GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name) x
